detail.longDescription: Your AI agent already helps you brainstorm video ideas, tighten scripts, and write descriptions. But when the chat ends, so does the help. Someone still has to share the new video in Slack, log it in a spreadsheet, and dig through the comments. Now you can automate YouTube from the AI tool you already use.
